reason: Duplicates are the easy part, I already catch those by checking myself. What burned me was a nota with the price written up, and a bot reading a handwritten shop nota can't tell me the real price was lower. I might play with the free 30, but I wouldn't pay for something that only does what my Excel check already does.
objection: My staff's nota are handwritten and messy. I don't believe a bot reads them right, and even if it does, a perfectly added-up nota can still be inflated. Totals that match don't mean nobody padded it.
would_change_my_mind: If in the free 30 it reads our handwritten nota correctly and flags when a price is out of line with what we normally pay for the same item at the same shop.
